review_candidates.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Midpoint Global is hiring a Senior Technical Project Manager in Jakarta. You would be accountable for delivery of our client projects from contract signature through to formal client acceptance. This is a project management role and does not involve writing code, but it does require enough technical understanding to challenge an estimate and read an integration design. ABOUT MIDPOINT Midpoint Global (PT Midpoint Teknologi Global) is a consulting firm based in Kuningan Barat, South Jakarta. We build and implement the systems companies use to find, win, serve, and bill their customers. Our clients are banks, telecommunication companies, airlines, hospitals, and universities in Indonesia. We work to our own delivery method. Each phase closes with a document signed by the client, requirements are confirmed and locked before design begins, and large projects are delivered in releases that go live one at a time. THE ROLE You work alongside a Tech Lead, who leads the solution design and the build, and a Senior Solution Engineer, who runs requirement discovery with the client. You are responsible for delivering within the agreed budget and timeline, closing each phase with a signed document, ensuring scope changes are priced and approved, and preventing unagreed work from entering the project. A single project can run for a year and deliver in several releases, each with its own user acceptance testing, go-live, and hypercare period. You would run that cycle more than once within the same project. PROJECTS YOU WOULD RUN CRM and lead management systems Lead-to-opportunity cycles Order capture and activation Omnichannel marketing activation Customer service and contact centre Invoicing, billing, and collections Customer identity resolution Dashboards and analytics Data and system migration AI enablement: customer segmentation and conversational AI Some of this work is built on cloud platforms and some is configured on licensed products. Most projects involve a combination of the two. RESPONSIBILITIES Take the project over from the presales team and review the signed contract against the proposal. Where the timeline, team, or assumptions do not support what was sold, raise it before the project starts. Write the project charter, RACI, stakeholder map, and project management plan, and get the charter signed. Build the work breakdown structure, schedule, and resource plan. Give every work package an owner and a mandays budget. Track spend against the mandays budget and progress against the schedule, and escalate early when either slips. Run the meetings: sprint reviews, a weekly status report to the client sponsor, and a monthly steering committee. Send minutes within one working day. Maintain a risk and issue log, review it weekly, and escalate items that are not moving. Keep requirement workshops on schedule, own the requirement traceability matrix, and follow up with client owners on outstanding decisions, data, and access. Ensure the Solution Design Document is complete and signed on schedule. The Tech Lead owns its content; you are accountable for it as a project milestone. Write the epics and user stories from the signed requirement documents. Each story carries background, the story itself, and acceptance criteria linked to a requirement ID. The Tech Lead adds technical notes and estimates, and the client product owner approves them. Keep sprints moving. Detail arriving late for work already agreed is refined into the story. A change to something already agreed or already built goes through change control. Stay close enough to the build to identify problems early. Follow the board and attend stand-ups rather than relying on the team to report blockers. Take blockers to the client and follow up until they are resolved: a decision, a data extract, an access request, an environment, or a response from their vendor. This sits with you, not with the engineers. Determine whether a request falls inside the contract or requires a change request, consulting the Senior Solution Engineer where the scope wording is unclear. Run change control: assess the impact on cost, schedule, and risk, and obtain signature before any changed work begins. Run UAT with the client business users, manage defects by severity, and hold the agreed exit criteria. Train the business users before go-live, together with the Senior Solution Engineer. Obtain the UAT sign-off and go-live approval for each release. Run hypercare for the period agreed in the contract, keep defects separate from new requests, and close the project with a signed handover document. Ensure every invoice milestone is supported by the required document and provide it to the account team on time. Lead the project team. The engineers, consultants, and client staff you work with do not report to you. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR At least five years managing software or platform implementation projects. At least two of them delivered end to end as the responsible project manager, from requirements through go-live to formal acceptance. Experience at a consulting firm, vendor, or system integrator, where the scope is fixed, the contract is signed, payment is tied to milestones, and the client signs off the work. Experience running change control. You can describe a change request you raised, how you assessed the impact, and how the conversation with the client went. Experience running UAT with business users, including defect triage and exit criteria. You have written or reviewed user stories and acceptance criteria, and can identify when an acceptance criterion is too vague to test. Experience managing more than one release inside a single project, each with its own acceptance. Professional Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken. Our client documents and workshops use both. Based in Greater Jakarta or willing to relocate, and available to work at client sites as projects require. NICE TO HAVE Delivery on SaaS products: Salesforce (Sales, Service, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud), Mixpanel, or similar licensed platforms. Delivery on cloud and data platforms: GCP, AWS, Tencent Cloud, Databricks, or similar, where the solution is built rather than configured. Experience in both modes is an advantage. Neither is required, and we recognise that most candidates are stronger in one than the other. Projects in a regulated industry such as banking, insurance, or telecommunications, and the additional security and compliance work they involve. Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, PSM, or SAFe. A background in engineering, business analysis, or solution consulting before moving into project management. TECHNICAL UNDERSTANDING You are not expected to build anything. You are expected to follow a technical discussion, identify weak assumptions, and explain the outcome to a business sponsor. Buy or build: whether a requirement is better met by configuring a licensed product or by building on cloud services, and what each choice costs over the life of the system. Integrations: REST and SOAP APIs, authentication and single sign-on, middleware, batch versus real-time patterns, and error handling. Enough depth to scope an integration, challenge an estimate, and direct the right questions to a client vendor. Data: data models and relationships, data quality, migration and cutover, and the cost of changing a data model once a release is live. Environments and releases: development, staging, and production environments, deployment and rollback, version control, and how the client release process constrains go-live dates. Security and compliance: role and permission models, data residency, personal data protection, and sector regulation such as OJK for financial services, enough to plan for a client security review. Non-functional requirements: user numbers, performance and availability targets, and translating them into criteria that can be tested. Technical documents: architecture diagrams, entity relationship diagrams, integration specifications, and API documentation. Delivery tools: ClickUp or Jira for backlog, sprint, and work breakdown tracking, and spreadsheets for effort and budget tracking. LEADERSHIP AND CONSULTING SKILLS Leading without authority: the people on your project do not report to you. Delivery depends on clarity and credibility rather than reporting lines. Senior stakeholder management: running a steering committee with a client sponsor, presenting variance and risk accurately, and keeping the session on agenda. Holding the scope line: informing a client that a request constitutes a change request, explaining the impact, and maintaining the relationship. Early escalation: informing the sponsor of a delay when it becomes foreseeable, not when it becomes unavoidable. Written clarity: status reports and minutes that are concise and specific, and state what decision is required, from whom, and by when. Judgement: where the scope does not clearly cover a request, you consult, decide, and record the decision, rather than escalating every item or deciding in isolation. Initiative: working close to the delivery team rather than waiting for status updates, and acting on what you observe. Developing others: developing the junior members of your team and leaving documentation the next person can work from. THE DETAILS Location: Jakarta Selatan, hybrid Employment type: Permanent Level: Senior, 5+ years Reports to: Head of Solutions & Delivery HOW TO APPLY Send your CV to rivaldi.fawzian@midpoint.id, or apply at this job post. Include a short note on one project you delivered end to end: what you were accountable for, what went wrong, and how you resolved it. #Hiring #ProjectManager #TechnicalProjectManager #ITProjectManager #Jakarta #Salesforce #DataCloud #Consulting

Über uns Die Adenion GmbH unterstützt mit ihren Online-Tools PR-Gateway und Blog2Social Unternehmen, Agenturen, Blogger:innen und Selbständige bei der professionellen Kommunikation im Netz – von Presseportalen über Blogs bis hin zu Social Media. Aufgaben Produkt- & E-Mail-Marketing Du unterstützt bei der Vermarktung von PR-Gateway und Blog2Social. Du entwickelst und optimierst mit Hilfe von KI-Tools E-Mail- und Leadkampagnen. Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Perplexity, um Texte zu schreiben und Ideen zu entwickeln. Du schreibst Newsletter-Texte auf Deutsch und Englisch, die unsere Zielgruppe wirklich ansprechen. Du kannst Dich gut in unsere Kunden hineinversetzen und weißt, was sie interessiert. Content & Community Du arbeitest an Blogbeiträgen, Landingpages und SEO-Texten, unterstützt durch KI. Du erstellst kurze Erklärvideos mit Tools wie Canva oder VEEDio. Du bringst unsere Inhalte dorthin, wo unsere Zielgruppe ist – z.B. auf Reddit, Quora oder in Fachforen, indem Du dort hilfreiche Antworten, nützliche Tipps und Empfehlungen gibst und echten Mehrwert bietest. Du kümmerst Dich um Kundenbewertungen und Erfahrungsberichte, damit neue Nutzer sehen, wie hilfreich unsere Tools sind. Qualifikation Zielgruppenverständnis first: Du kannst Dich sehr gut in unsere Nutzer hineinversetzen und weißt, was sie interessiert. Du hast Erfahrung im E-Mail- und Online-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B-Bereich. Du interessierst Dich für künstliche Intelligenz und Prompting. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und denkst lösungsorientiert. Du kennst Dich mit Online- & KI-Tools, Social Media Plattformen und idealerweise WordPress aus. Auch als Student:in, Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in mit relevanter Erfahrung bist Du herzlich willkommen. Benefits Vielfältige Projekte rund um Digital Marketing & KI Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum Kollegiales, hilfsbereites Team mit Start-up-Flair und flachen Hierarchien Individuelle Einarbeitung & persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Remote-Work Option Offene Kommunikationskultur mit Duz-Mentalität Regelmäßige Teammeetings & kurze Entscheidungswege Neugierig geworden? review_candidates.title: M&A Associate - Large Cap - Buldge Bracket Investment Bank
review_candidates.description: We are recruiting an M&A Associate for the Amsterdam office of a leading global investment bank. The platform sits at the top of the Benelux league tables and executes the largest, most complex transactions in the market: public takeovers of Euronext Amsterdam-listed companies, cross-border strategic mergers, carve-outs from Dutch and Belgian industrial groups, and sponsor-led large-cap situations. What makes this seat unusual is the combination of scale and access. The Amsterdam team is deliberately lean, so Associates work directly with senior bankers and sit in front of CFOs, boards and Supervisory Board members rather than behind three layers of process. Deal flow is genuinely large cap and genuinely cross-border, with full support from the bank's global sector and financing platforms. Recent Benelux activity has been strong, with Dutch deal volumes running ahead of the three-year average and both strategic and financial buyers active, so the pipeline is live rather than theoretical. What you will do Lead day-to-day execution on M&A transactions: valuation, financial modelling, due diligence coordination, documentation and closing Build and own DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution and trading and transaction comparables analyses Draft board materials, pitch books, information memoranda and management presentations Manage and mentor Analysts, and act as the central point of contact for clients, lawyers and advisers Support origination for large-cap Dutch and Belgian corporates and sponsor coverage What you need 3–5 years of M&A or corporate finance experience from an investment bank, or elite boutique Demonstrable execution on mid- to large-cap transactions, ideally with public markets or cross-border exposure Strong technical foundation: modelling, valuation, accounting Languages: fluency in Dutch or French or Belgium is essential, with a good working command of the second. Degree in finance, economics, business or a comparable quantitative discipline Right to work in the Netherlands, or willingness to relocate to Amsterdam What is on offer Bulge bracket compensation, benchmarked at the top of the Amsterdam market, with a meaningful bonus component Genuine large-cap deal exposure and early client responsibility Clear promotion track to VP, with internal mobility across the bank's European network Relocation support where relevant
